title: ScoredReplayResult
description: Scored Postgame Replay milestone: one market's postgame scoring, linked to the immutable ReplayResult it scores. Every prediction/tier/recommendation field here is copied verbatim from that ReplayResult's own `original*` fields (the actual pregame/forward output) -- never recomputed, never the `replayed*` (current-code re-run) fields. See docs/SCORED_REPLAY.md.

replayResultId.description: The immutable ReplayResult this scores. That row is never modified by this record's existence.

selection.description: Market name as evaluated (e.g. 'ML_Away'), copied verbatim from ReplayResult.selection.

modelEvaluationId.description: Set only when a genuine ModelEvaluation record was found ingested for this exact (marketTicker, selection) -- never derived by recomputing the id hash against a record that may not exist.

recommendationId.description: Set only when a genuine Recommendation record was found ingested for this exact (marketTicker, marketName) -- same never-reconstruct discipline as modelEvaluationId.

predictionStatus.description: UNAVAILABLE when ReplayResult.originalModelProbability is null -- the market was in the ledger (e.g. Missing Data / Evaluation Failed / a structurally unpriced market) but the model never produced a pregame probability for it. Never guessed.

predictedFairProbability.description: Copied verbatim from ReplayResult.originalModelProbability (percent, 0-100) -- the model's actual pregame fair probability, never the replayed/current-code re-run.

marketProbabilityPregame.description: ReplayResult.originalExecutableMarketProb, falling back to originalMarketPrice only when the executable field itself was never populated -- the market/executable probability recorded pregame, never a later or closing price.

recommendationActionStatus.description: Copied verbatim from ReplayResult.originalRecommendationStatus (e.g. 'Accepted', 'Rejected', 'Missing Data', 'Evaluation Failed').

result.description: Copied verbatim from ReplayResult.settlementLinkage.result -- never recomputed, never inferred from a related-but-different market.

value.description: Percentage-point CLV (closing implied probability minus entry implied probability), copied verbatim from ReplayResult.clvLinkage.clvValue. That linkage is built exclusively from the isClosingQuote=True quote -- a valid pre-suspension/pre-first-pitch close by construction (lib.edgelab.clv.select_closing_quote) -- never a later, post-close, or non-closing price.

evaluationStage.description: PREDICTION_UNAVAILABLE takes priority (nothing else can be classified without a prediction). CONFIRMED_BET requires a genuine, non-CANCELLED PlacedBet linked via canonical settlement.betId. RECOMMENDED_NO_CONFIRMED_BET requires recommendationActionStatus=='Accepted' with no such bet. Otherwise EVALUATED_NO_BET_PLACED.

betId.description: Set only when a real PlacedBet/settlement.betId link exists -- never fabricated.

result.description: Canonical PlacedBet.result -- present only for evaluationStage=='CONFIRMED_BET'.

grossReturn.description: lib.edgelab.bets.realized_bet_economics()'s gross return -- reuses the canonical confirmed-receipt-preferred calculation, never recomputed here.

netProfitLoss.description: lib.edgelab.bets.realized_bet_economics()'s net P/L -- the sole source for realized betting P/L aggregation.

binaryOutcome.description: 1 if objectiveOutcome.result=='YES' else 0, present only when brierScore is also present -- the exact pair brierScore was computed from.

brierScore.description: (predictedFairProbability/100 - binaryOutcome)^2. Null unless BOTH predictionStatus=='AVAILABLE' and objectiveOutcome.settlementStatus=='MARKET_SETTLED' with a genuine YES/NO result -- never computed from a partial pair.
